Accurate and consistent with clause 5.

Accurate.

PLANS.md 9.3 Objective (3645-3652) and Work bullet (3665-3669): now validate-first ('validate the candidate first; for a valid candidate call base.UpdateConfiguration ... and then TryReplace; an invalid candidate is never passed to base, so it is never persisted'). Accurate.
